status_summary: The FY2026 budget request, released 2025-05-30, proposed a State-based Rental Assistance Block Grant merging five rental programs at $31.79 billion, with two-year assistance limits for non-elderly, non-disabled households, folded Continuum of Care and HOPWA into an expanded Emergency Solutions Grants program, and proposed eliminating CDBG and HOME. The FY2027 request of 2026-04-03 again proposed eliminating CDBG and HOME, replaced Continuum of Care with a larger Emergency Solutions Grant program and eliminated HOPWA, and did not repeat the rental assistance block grant (HUD section, pp. 29-32). A HUD internal reorganization notice previewed on 2026-09-04 was withdrawn the same day and did not, as reported, move functions to other agencies or states. No proposal to move programs to SBA or Interior, or to create a successor housing agency, was found.

timeline.event: The FY2026 budget request proposed a State-based Rental Assistance Block Grant and elimination of CDBG and HOME.

The FY2027 budget request proposed eliminating CDBG, HOME, HOPWA and Continuum of Care, funding Emergency Solutions Grants at $4 billion, without a rental assistance block grant (HUD section, pp. 29-32).
HUD's reorganization notice was previewed for publication and withdrawn the same day.
